messages.author: 1ca9bfce5ea5e0bd
messages.subject: map failing
parts:
I am using rmr1.1. The mapping is failing and when I checked the logs I found the following error in one the syslog files:
2012-03-03 12:44:18,982 INFO org.apache.hadoop.mapred.Task: Aborting job with ru
nstate : FAILED

messages.author: 63023c771a070260
messages.subject: Re: map failing
parts:
Three suggestions:
  1. Upgrade to rmr 1.2 so that we can focus our effort on one version
  2. Post a reproducible example with data and everything. If I can reproduce it with my setup, you are guaranteed I am going to try and debug it. Otherwise I can just give you some ideas on what can be going on. This suggestions implies number 1 (I have 1.2 installed, as you can imagine)
  3. Check the userlogs, not the syslogs. The syslogs might tell you about bugs in Hadoop, but not rmr or your own code
I hope this helps


A

messages.author: 1ca9bfce5ea5e0bd
messages.subject: Re: map failing
parts: In Hadoop there is /log/userlogs/ folder that contains logs for each job. And each job contains the respective map and reduce attempts. To check an attempt you have to look at the associated syslog, stderr and stdout files. And that is the syslog am looking at.
